title: RoboSimStudio: An Interactive Toolkit for Human and Agent Rapid Real2Sim of Robot Manipulation Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2610.18835v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: It has been difficult to accurately model the physics of the interaction between a robot and the objects it manipulates, including contact mechanics, coupled contact dynamics, deformations, stiffness and friction. We present RoboSimStudio (RSS), an interactive toolkit that makes choices of solver, contact model, and physical parameters explicit and editable, allowing both humans and coding agents to quickly create and iteratively refine simulations based on observed physical behavior. We implement RSS with the open Newton physics simulation system and describe experiments with human-guided real2sim using (1) visual evaluation, (2) force-feedback and (3) agentic Real2Sim2Real. Code, video and additional information can be found on the project website: https://robosimstudio.github.io

translated_title: RoboSimStudio：面向人类与智能体快速实现机器人操作任务Real2Sim的交互式工具包
translated_abstract: 准确建模机器人与其所操作物体之间交互的物理特性一直十分困难，这些物理特性包括接触力学、耦合接触动力学、形变、刚度与摩擦。我们提出了RoboSimStudio（RSS），这是一个交互式工具包，它将求解器、接触模型和物理参数的选择变得明确且可编辑，使人类和编程智能体都能基于观察到的物理行为快速创建并迭代改进仿真。我们基于开源的Newton物理仿真系统实现了RSS，并通过人类引导的real2sim实验展示了其应用，包括（1）视觉评估、（2）力反馈以及（3）智能体Real2Sim2Real。代码、视频及更多信息可在项目网站获取：https://robosimstudio.github.io
tldr: 该论文提出交互式工具包RoboSimStudio，通过将求解器、接触模型和物理参数的选择显式化且可编辑，使人类与编程智能体能够基于观察到的物理行为快速构建并迭代优化机器人操作任务的Real2Sim仿真。
en_tdlr: This paper presents RoboSimStudio, an interactive toolkit that makes solver, contact model, and physical parameter choices explicit and editable, enabling both humans and coding agents to rapidly create and iteratively refine Real2Sim simulations of robot manipulation tasks based on observed physical behavior.
